text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘The Tiger’ (बाघ)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘The Tiger’ (Baagh). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘The Tiger’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘national’ मतलब राष्ट्रीय। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘national’ matlab rashtriya. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘national’ means राष्ट्रीय. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘stripes’ मतलब धारियाँ। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘stripes’ matlab dhaariyan. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘stripes’ means धारियाँ. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘protect’ मतलब रक्षा करना। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘protect’ matlab raksha karna. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘protect’ means रक्षा करना. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: The tiger is the national animal of India.
It is the biggest cat in the world.
A tiger has orange fur with black stripes.
No two tigers have the same stripes.
They hunt at night and sleep in the day.
Today there are not many tigers left, so we must protect their forests.

question.hi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय पशु कौन है?
question.hinglish: Bharat ka rashtriya pashu kaun hai?
question.en: What is the national animal of India?
